concept: Linear Equation in 2 or more Variables
question: If (9x - 3y) = 96 and 4x:3y = 20:21 , then find the value of (2x² + 3y²) .
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ From the ratio 4x : 3y = 20 : 21, we get x/y = (20/4) / (21/3) = 5/7. Let x = 5k and y = 7k. Substitute in 9x − 3y = 96. 9(5k) − 3(7k) = 96 ⇒ 45k − 21k = 96 ⇒ 24k = 96 ⇒ k = 4. Therefore, x = 20 and y = 28. Required value = 2(20)² + 3(28)² = 800 + 2352 = 3152. **∴ The correct answer is 3152.**
